answer: Tie voting weight to emergency-response rotations. Each identity locks 29 POA and accepts four randomly scheduled incident drills per epoch for 13 epochs. An ember beacon reveals one encrypted fault at a time; five of eight auditors verify signed diagnosis traces against hidden logs. Trust climbs a ridge only after 18 correct drills, while matching traces share one reward. A sparrow swarm of N aliases needs 4N independent responses and locks 29N POA; two missed drills burn each bond.
